name: field-lock-test-031a81a52d/locks-in-object-v.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: "[Lock statement](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#lock-stmt)" is listed, but named worker declarations are not included in the supported statements.

## Expressions: "[Start action](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#start-action)" and "[Wait action](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#wait-action)" are listed; these do not cover named worker declarations.
reason: The case requires named workers (`worker w1`) in three functions to run concurrent object updates under locks. Named worker declarations are outside the subset's positive feature lists, so the asserted concurrent locking behavior is not wholly supported, despite lock statements and runtime:sleep being supported.
unsupported_constructs: Named worker declarations and their concurrent execution/completion semantics.
test_design_notes: The first @output asserts an exact ordered sequence of 1000 '#' characters followed by 1000 '*' characters; the other outputs assert both increments complete, yielding 1001000. These assertions depend on worker execution and scheduling/completion behavior.
io:println is output instrumentation; runtime:sleep is explicitly allowed and does not independently make this a feature case.
